from cloud.services.agent_runner.langfuse.models import (
    LangfuseHandles,
    LangfuseRunIdentity,
    LangfuseScoreRequest,
)


def _fake_langfuse_handles(client: _FakeLangfuseClient) -> LangfuseHandles:
    return LangfuseHandles(
        callback=object(),
        client=client,
        identity=LangfuseRunIdentity(
            run_id="test-run",
            langfuse_trace_id=_LANGFUSE_TRACE_ID,
            app_trace_id=None,
            request_id=None,
            plan_id=None,
            platform="workday",
            target_url=None,
            operator_id="operator",
            metadata={},
        ),
        attribute_scope=nullcontext,
        dataset_export_enabled=False,
        dataset_name="job-hunter-agent-runs",
    )
    observer = LangfuseRunObserver(handles=_fake_langfuse_handles(client), payload={})
    handles = _fake_langfuse_handles(_FakeLangfuseClient())
